scientific_integrity: All count and symmetry formulas follow from a connected tight-edge classification; exact finite tests verify six initial instances but do not substitute for the infinite-family proof. Close prior literature and possible unindexed equivalences are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for real scalar Lipschitz-free spaces and one single once-subdivided edge of a complete graph, with unit edge lengths; no broader metric perturbation theorem is asserted.
The orbit group consists of graph automorphisms and central inversion; unrestricted linear automorphisms of the polytope are not classified.
The exact program examines orders 5 through 10 only. The all-orders formulas rest on a separate analytic proof.
Published small-case facet tables may already include individual numerical counts; only the whole structural theorem is assessed for originality.
title: Facet rigidity under one-edge subdivision of a complete-graph transportation ball
